title: Calming strategies
examples: What can I do when I feel really cross?
Can you show me how to take a big breath?
Where is the quiet corner in the classroom?

explain.say: When big feelings come, we need ways to feel calm.

draw.text: Calming strategies help us feel calm.

explain.say: Let us try belly breathing together right now.

draw.text: Belly breathing: breathe in, breathe out.

explain.say: Imagine you are blowing up a big, round balloon slowly.

draw.text: Breathe in like a balloon, out like a sigh.

explain.say: Next, we can use our counting skills to help us settle down.

draw.text: Count slowly to ten while breathing.

explain.say: We can also go to a quiet space when we need a break.

draw.text: Quiet space for a moment of calm.

explain.say: When you feel frustrated with a puzzle, you can take three deep breaths. This helps your body calm down a little bit. It is a good way to restart your focus.

draw.text: Deep breaths help calm big feelings.

faq.q: What should I do if I feel angry?
faq.a: You can try taking three slow, deep belly breaths. This helps your body feel safer.
asks: How do I calm down fast?

faq.q: Is counting always a good way to calm down?
faq.a: Yes, counting helps you focus your mind on something slow. It gives your thoughts something to do.
asks: Is counting okay when I am upset?

faq.a: A quiet space is a spot where you can sit alone for a few minutes. It helps you rest your busy feelings.
asks: Where can I go to be quiet?

faq.q: Do I have to breathe with my tummy?
faq.a: Yes, try to make your tummy move out when you breathe in. This is deep breathing for your body.

faq.q: Can I use all these things at once?
faq.a: It is best to choose just one thing to try first. Pick one strategy that sounds easy right now.
asks: Which one should I start with?

facts: Deep breathing helps send calm messages to your brain.
Counting helps to focus your mind when you feel overwhelmed.
A quiet space gives your body time to rest and recharge.
It is okay to need help when your feelings are big.

quiz.say: When you feel upset, what is a good first thing to try?
quiz.show: Belly breathing helps calm big feelings.
quiz.why: Belly breathing is a good way to start calming your body down.

wrong.0: Running around uses up energy when you need to rest it.
wrong.1: Yelling makes your feelings louder instead of quieter.
wrong.2: Food helps your tummy, but breathing helps your feelings.

quiz.say: If you need a break, where can you go?
quiz.show: A quiet space helps you rest your feelings.
quiz.why: A quiet space is a safe spot to sit and let your feelings settle.

wrong.0: A noisy area can make big feelings even bigger.
wrong.2: Under the table is not a safe or comfortable place to rest.
wrong.3: Playing is fun, but sometimes you need quiet rest first.

quiz.say: To help your breathing, you should make your tummy:
quiz.show: Breathe in: tummy out, breathe out: tummy in.

options.show: Move only when you are tired
options.say: Move only when you are tired

options.show: Move out when you breathe in
options.say: Move out when you breathe in

quiz.why: Making your tummy move out when you breathe in shows you are breathing deep.

wrong.0: You can breathe deeply even when you are calm or cross.
wrong.1: Breathing helps you feel calm anytime you need it.
wrong.3: If your tummy stays flat, you are not taking a deep breath.
